summary: Completed Production Readiness pretest with setup checks and evidence-backed responses on deployment safety, health checks, monitoring risk, and graceful degradation.
evidence: Setup checks passed: docker 28.4.0, node v24.11.1, git 2.52.0.windows.1, curl 8.17.0 on Windows bash; no missing tools or setup errors.
Q2: Correctly distinguished Dockerfile (build instructions) vs image (immutable built artifact used to run containers).
Q3: Identified production-only risks despite local passing tests: environment/config differences and concurrency/performance race behaviors.
Q4: Correctly differentiated liveness vs readiness and explained why traffic gating needs readiness, not just process up-state.
Q5: Chose metric-driven incident response with fast rollback when regression is confirmed.
Q6: Chose prevention-first shipping posture: invest in testing/monitoring/safe deploy practices to reduce user impact and avoidable failure cost.
Q7: Identified no-monitoring risk: lack of visibility delays detection of outages, degradation, and silent corruption.
Q8: Defined graceful degradation as preserving core functionality by reducing non-critical features during partial failure.
artifacts: production-readiness pretest answers in session chat
